title: Q-ASHBY-ledger: Step trials, commits and rollbacks have no table, so interference() and failureRecall() cannot read live data
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** SECOND-LOOP-KERNEL-1 merged (PR 2629); work record issue 2620
**Done check:** cmd:git grep -q step_trials -- seed/worker/src/secondloop.js
**Closing probe:** `node --test seed/worker/test/secondloop.test.js seed/worker/test/organization.test.js` passes with a test that exercises it, and `git grep -q step_trials -- seed/worker/src/secondloop.js` exits 0
**Prediction:** ashby_concepts_implemented >= 18 within 336 h
**Out of scope:** copying any text or image from ashby.info; blind random search

Problem: Step trials, commits and rollbacks have no table, so interference() and failureRecall() cannot read live data. Build: a migration adding step_trials(partition, candidate, start_tick, outcome) and a tick read that calls interference and evoke.
